# Cloud-native assessment

Apply only to technologies present in scope.

- Identity: workload identity, short-lived credentials, federation, role trust, tenant boundaries, privilege escalation paths.
- Network: public exposure, private endpoints, ingress and egress, east-west policy, DNS, metadata services, cross-account or cross-project paths.
- Workloads: non-root execution, capabilities, seccomp, immutable filesystem, resource limits, isolation, node and runtime risks.
- Supply chain: provenance, signed artifacts, SBOM, dependency and image scanning, registry controls, deployment admission policy.
- Secrets and keys: central storage, envelope encryption, rotation, access logs, break-glass paths, separation of duties.
- Resilience: quotas, backpressure, regional failure, restore tests, dependency timeout and circuit-breaking behavior.
- Detection: control-plane audit, workload telemetry, immutable retention, correlation, alert ownership, incident response.

Do not translate a cloud-service name directly into a control claim. Verify configuration and scope.
